PAGE TITLE: FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, NOTES, AND REQUIRED SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION / REQUIRED SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION / Deferred Maintenance and Repairs for FY 2024

KEY FACTS:
- In FY 2022, NASA revised its approach to facility assessments and DM&R calculations to enhance accuracy.
- NASA conducts Full Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) every five years for assets with a Current Replacement Value (CRV) over $500,000.
- The revised assessments evaluate 20 systems, up from the previous nine.
- FY 2022 marked the start of a transitional period, with all Centers expected to be assessed by FY 2026.
